title: 第9章 疗伤遇宝露真相第10章 竹楼突变引关注
slug: 签到玄天我成了万界守护者
content_zh:
方浩的右手中指抽了一下，像是被针扎进指甲缝里。
他低头看去，皮肤完好无损，可那一丝凉意却顺着指尖爬上了手臂，隐隐发麻。
他没停下脚步，三步并作两步穿过林子，回到竹楼。
门一关，立刻扯下腰间青铜鼎往桌上一放，右手藏进袖口，指尖悄悄掐了自己一下——疼，说明不是幻觉。
“系统，今天签到。”
他在心里默念。
片刻安静。
然后一道光浮现在脑海，像是谁往他脑子里扔了颗发光的松子。
【签到成功，获得“愈伤松子”
一枚。
他掌心一翻，一颗墨绿色的果子落在手中，表面有金色纹路游走，像活的一样。
若是在外头坊市，顶多被人当成三灵石一颗的低阶疗伤果，毕竟灵气稀薄，连个波动都没有。
“系统出品，绝不坑爹。”
他嘟囔一句，把松子塞进嘴里。
果子入口即化，没味儿，也没动静。
他等了等，体内依旧那股子凉飕飕的血线在游，像是条小蛇顺着经脉乱钻。
“搞什么？连个嗝都不打？”
他皱眉，盘腿坐下，运转功法准备强行疏导。
刚引动灵气，胸口猛地一烫。
不是痛，是滚烫，仿佛有人往他五脏六腑里倒了一壶开水。

紧接着，一股热流从丹田炸开，直冲四肢百骸，像是全身血管里突然烧起了火。
“哎哟卧槽！”
他差点从地上弹起来。
这哪是疗伤？这是要炼尸！
热流与那股凉血线撞在一起，一个往里烧，一个往外渗，两股劲儿在他经脉里干上了。
他咬牙硬撑，可意识已经开始发飘，眼前一黑，整个人栽进了某种说不清道不明的境地。
……
火光冲天。
一座熔炉前，一个赤膊大汉正抡着铁锤猛砸一块青铜。
火星四溅，每砸一下，空中就浮现出一道星纹，像是把天上的北斗七颗星一颗颗钉进金属里。
大汉喘着粗气，背影宽阔，左肩上有个印记，形状残缺，像被什么咬掉了一角。
content_en:
Fang Hao's middle finger on his right hand twitched, as if a needle had been stuck between his nails.
He looked down and saw that his skin was intact, but a hint of coolness crept up his fingertips, making him feel faintly numb.
He didn't stop and walked through the forest in three steps and two steps at a time, returning to the bamboo house.
As soon as the door closed, he immediately took off the bronze cauldron from his waist and put it on the table. He hid his right hand in his cuff and pinched himself quietly with his fingertips - it hurt, which meant it was not an illusion.
"System, sign in today."
He thought silently in his mind.
A moment of silence.
Then a light appeared in his mind, as if someone had thrown a glowing pine nut into his head.
[Sign in successfully and get "Healing Pine Nuts"
One piece.
He turned his palm, and a dark green fruit fell into his hand. There were golden lines on the surface, as if it were alive.
If it were in the outer market, it would at most be regarded as a low-level healing fruit with three spiritual stones. After all, the spiritual energy is so thin that it doesn't even fluctuate.
"Produced by the system, it will never cheat you."
He muttered and stuffed the pine nuts into his mouth.
The fruit melts in your mouth, tasteless and motionless.
He waited, and the cold blood line was still swimming in his body, like a small snake slithering along his meridians.
"What are you doing? You don't even burp?"
He frowned, sat down cross-legged, and started to use his skills to prepare for forced relief.
As soon as he activated his spiritual energy, his chest suddenly felt hot.
It wasn't painful, it was hot, as if someone had poured a pot of boiling water into his internal organs.
Immediately afterwards, a stream of heat exploded from the Dantian and rushed straight to the limbs and bones, as if the blood vessels in the whole body were suddenly on fire.
"Oh shit!"
He nearly bounced off the ground.
How is this healing? This is to refine the corpse!
The hot current collided with the cold blood line, one burning inward, the other seeping out, and the two forces worked in his meridians.
He gritted his teeth and held on, but his consciousness had begun to wander, his vision went dark, and he fell into some inexplicable situation.
…
Fire shot into the sky.
In front of a furnace, a shirtless man was pounding a piece of bronze with a hammer.
Sparks flew everywhere, and with each hit, a star pattern appeared in the sky, as if the Big Dipper stars in the sky were nailed into the metal one by one.
The big man was breathing heavily, his back was broad, and there was a mark on his left shoulder. The shape was incomplete, as if a corner had been bitten off by something.
